title: Docstyle serialized semantic document model, version 1

semantics.description: Additive v1 revision (metadata-binding spec, section 4): semantic attributes for table and figure nodes. Deliberately unconstrained at rest so previously valid values stay valid. Canonical forms are $defs/table-semantics and $defs/figure-semantics; the semantic validator dispatches by node type and applies them before embedding, and catalogue.v1 applies them to its objects. A noncanonical value warns at rest and blocks embedding until explicitly normalized; it is never silently discarded or reinterpreted. Presentation data (widths, alignment, borders, image size, wrapping, anchoring) never belongs here.

credit.description: Additive v1 revision (metadata-binding spec, section 4). Unconstrained at rest so existing values stay valid; canonical form is $defs/credit, validated by the semantic validator before embedding and by $defs/canonical-asset in catalogue.v1.

record-reference.description: Reference to an authority record by id (never a metadata-view). Used as the structured form of credit and provenance.

credit.description: Canonical credit: a plain statement, or a prunable record reference -- when the referenced record is restricted the embedder removes the whole credit property, never only the nested record key.

provenance.description: Canonical provenance: a plain statement, or a prunable record reference (same pruning rule as credit).

profile-extensions.description: Namespaced extension container keyed by registered profile identifier (<namespace>:<name>). Each value is validated by that profile's own schema in the semantic validator; a profile never adds loose core fields.

table-semantics.description: Canonical table semantics (closed). caption and notes are node-id references resolved against the document's field-envelope ids at embed time.

notes.description: Node ids of table-note content nodes.

figure-semantics.description: Canonical figure semantics (closed). alt is required by the catalogue embedder for public figures (catalogue.v1 enforces it on embedded objects). asset is a closure-required reference into the asset registry.

asset.description: Closure-required reference to an asset registry id.

canonical-asset.description: Canonical, portable asset record (path, mediaType, hash, optional canonical credit) as carried by catalogue.v1. Closed so local-only data such as source paths cannot ride along. Wrapper pattern: the reused $defs/asset sits in anyOf because keywords beside $ref are ignored.
